title: Cookie Policy - Atlas Mentor MBBS Abroad
description: Details on the cookies and similar tracking technologies used on atlasmentor.com, what they are used for, and how to control them.
body:
Cookie Policy

Last updated: September 2026

This Cookie Policy explains how Atlas Mentor (operated by Elitestudy Abroad Pvt. Ltd.) uses cookies and similar technologies on atlasmentor.com.

What Are Cookies

Cookies are small text files placed on your device by websites you visit. They are widely used to make websites function, work more efficiently, and to provide information to site owners.

How We Use Cookies

  • Essential cookies: required for core site functionality, such as submitting enquiry forms.
  • Analytics cookies: help us understand how visitors use the site (e.g. which pages are most viewed) so we can improve content and navigation.
  • Preference cookies: remember choices you've made so we don't need to ask again on your next visit.

Third-Party Cookies

Some cookies may be set by third-party services we use, such as analytics providers or advertising/remarketing platforms, in accordance with their own privacy policies.

Managing Cookies

Most web browsers let you control cookies through their settings, including blocking or deleting cookies. Please note that disabling cookies may affect the functionality of forms and other features on this site.

Contact Us

Questions about this Cookie Policy can be sent to info@atlasmentor.com.

This policy is provided for general informational purposes and should be reviewed by qualified legal counsel to ensure full compliance with applicable regional cookie/consent regulations.
